rationale: IDXX has already gapped up 13.4% on strong earnings beats and is trading at 77% of today's range with price well above VWAP ($645.22) and the 9-EMA ($645.81), suggesting the initial catalyst move is largely priced in. The spread is wide at 26 bps on a $653 stock, and with 267 minutes remaining, chasing a post-earnings gap this extended carries asymmetric risk — a long risks buying near the high of a gap-and-fade, while a short faces a stock with strong fundamental momentum and elevated relative volume (6.1x) that could squeeze further. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear enough to warrant standing aside.
